scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
We've received orders from Headquarters to block access to this area since an unusual space-time phenomenon has been detected.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
我们接到总部的命令，由于检测到异常的空间时间现象，必须封锁该区域的入口。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
If you really want to go to the next area, you'll be responsible for your own safety.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
如果您执意要前往下一个区域，后果需由您自行承担。

scripts.text: Nevermind.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text: Enter the Field.
scripts.translation: 进入该区域

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
Wise choice.
Have a safe journey.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
明智的选择。
祝您旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Continental Guard]
I see.
I'll send you to the field shortly.
scripts.translation:
[大陆卫兵]
我明白了。
我这就送您过去。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
I can't believe a mummy could do this to me. Oh man, it hurts. Nobody should find out about this....
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
真不敢相信，一只木乃伊竟然对我做了这种事。哎呀，好痛。绝对不能让任何人知道这件事...

scripts.text: Mummy? What happened?
scripts.translation: 木乃伊？发生什么事了？

scripts.text: Pretend not to know anything.
scripts.translation: 假装不知道

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
You caught me! Darn it...I didn't expect my reputation as a tomb raider would get damaged like this...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
被你发现了！该死...没想到我作为盗墓者的名声会因此受损...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
But come on, they're so strange! They're mummies! Just mummies, you know? They shouldn't be that strong!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
但是拜托了，它们太奇怪了！它们就是木乃伊啊！普通的木乃伊而已，不应该那么强的！

scripts.text: Strong mummies? Where are they?
scripts.translation: 强大的木乃伊？它们在哪里？

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Whaaat~ you don't want to hear my story? Fine! You'd better not mention my name anywhere else!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
哇啊~你不想听我的故事？好吧！你最好别在别处提起我的名字！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Haha, it's a secret.
I found out while I was stealing... No, I mean, just walking through the pyramid.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
哈哈，这是个秘密。
我是在偷...不，我是说在金字塔里闲逛时发现的。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
When I saw a mummy coming toward me, I was like 'whatever' and didn't care. But then he knocked me down with a slap in the face! How could he do that to a cute cat like me! You bandaged freak... you just wait and see!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
当我看到一只木乃伊朝我走来时，我想“无所谓”就没在意。结果它一巴掌把我打倒了！它怎么能对像我这样可爱的猫做这种事！你这个缠着绷带的怪人...你给我等着瞧！

scripts.text: I would like to go, too.
scripts.translation: 我也想一起去

scripts.text: End the conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
No way! I spent so much time finding that path!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
没门！我花了那么多时间才找到那条路！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Hmm... but if you insist, just give me 5000 Zeny. I'll lead you.
What~? Don't give me that look! Do you have any idea how hard it is for a cat to survive in Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
嗯...不过如果你坚持的话，给我5000 Zeny，我就带你去。
什么~？别用那种眼神看我！你知道一只猫在米德加尔特生存有多难吗！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
^FF0000But come to think of it, a weakling like you won't survive there. Maybe for a second if you're lucky?^000000
Well, it's none of my business. But I warned you anyway!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
^FF0000不过仔细想想，像你这样的弱者在那里活不过一秒。运气好也许能撑一秒？^000000
反正这不关我的事。但我已经警告过你了！

scripts.text: Pay 5,000 zeny and set out.
scripts.translation: 支付5000 Zeny并出发

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Where do you think you're going! You're so broke!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
你想去哪儿！你身无分文！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Bah, what's up with this old money... you don't have anything sparkly or shiny?!
Ahh, just follow me!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
啧，这些旧钱是怎么回事...难道你身上没有闪闪发光的东西吗？！
啊，跟着我就行了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Gosh, you don't even have 5000 Zeny, do you?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
天哪，你连5000 Zeny都没有吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
That stupid mummy slapped me again while you were looking away! Sniff sniff... Let's go back, meow!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
那只愚蠢的木乃伊趁你走神又打了我一巴掌！吸吸鼻子...我们回去吧，喵！

scripts.text: Go back to Thief Guild
scripts.translation: 返回盗贼公会

scripts.text: Eliminate Verit
scripts.translation: 消灭毕莱特

scripts.text: Eliminate Ancient Mummy
scripts.translation: 消灭狂暴木乃伊

scripts.text: It's nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Right right... let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
好吧好吧...我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Look at that Verit, he's afraid of us! Kyaahaha! We're safe, at least for a while!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
看那只毕莱特，他怕我们呢！呀哈哈！至少暂时安全了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Did you know that cats and dogs don't get along?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
你知道猫和狗是不合得来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Look at that ugly and hideous Verit. He's scowling, wagging his tail and trying to come closer.
Oh, you don't have a tail, right? He thinks I'm a thorn in his side, and he's trying to start a fight now!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
看那只丑陋又难看的毕莱特。他皱着眉头，摇着尾巴，还想靠近。
哦，你没有尾巴，对吧？他觉得我是他的眼中钉，现在想跟我打架了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Look at him, so greedy and drooly... I don't like the way he breathes, either. I can't stand how he's making those gobbling sounds...
It's so obvious that he's waiting to attack me from behind.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
看他那副贪婪流口水的样子...我也不喜欢他的呼吸方式。我受不了他发出那种吞咽的声音...
很明显，他在等着从背后偷袭我。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Gosh, I could have scratched his face so hard if it wasn't for my stomachache!
Hey, it's not because I'm afraid of Majoruros!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
天哪，要不是我肚子疼，我早就狠狠抓花他的脸了！
嘿，我才不是怕狂暴米诺斯呢！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
If you want to go home, you'd better beat up that ugly doggie! Otherwise, he'll bite you!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
如果你想回家，最好揍扁那只丑陋的小狗！否则，他会咬你的！

scripts.text: Help him
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Stay away
scripts.translation: 保持距离

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Good, the target number is 20! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
很好，目标是20只！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Pah! You don't care about me? Fine, you traitor!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
哼！你不在乎我吗？好吧，你这个叛徒！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Is Verit's training going well?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
毕莱特的训练进展得怎么样？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I want to stop.
scripts.translation: 我想停止。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Good. Keep up the good work!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
很好。继续保持！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
What? You're so irresponsible!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
什么？你太不负责任了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Hey, you're actually useful! Good job!
That Verit wouldn't dare come around here for a while, right? Muhahah!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
嘿，你果然派上用场了！干得好！
这样毕莱特短时间内就不敢靠近这里了，对吧？穆哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Good, I'll make a good use of the time you gained! But I gotta do something about this stomachache first.....
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
很好，我会好好利用你争取来的时间！不过我得先解决一下肚子疼的问题.....

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Precious treasures are supposed to be hidden in the deep secret places here!
I'm sure the mummy's precious treasures are hidden in the second basement level.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
珍贵的宝物应该就藏在这里深处的秘密地方！
我确信木乃伊的珍贵宝物藏在地下二层。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
But Ancient Mummies caught me off guard and hit my head before I knew it!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
但是狂暴木乃伊让我猝不及防，还没反应过来就撞到了我的头！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
I'm sure they're trying to stop me from finding the treasures by decreasing my superior brain cells!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
我确信它们是想通过减少我优秀的脑细胞来阻止我找到宝物！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
They can't stop me! Let's go get rid of Ancient Mummies!!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
它们阻止不了我！让我们去消灭狂暴木乃伊吧！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Don't ask why! I'm sure you wouldn't want those beautiful treasures to be hidden in the dark either!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
别问为什么！你肯定也不希望那些美丽的宝物被藏在黑暗里吧！

scripts.text: Help him
scripts.translation: 帮助他

scripts.text: Stay away
scripts.translation: 保持距离

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Alright, the target number is 20! Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
好了，目标是20只！祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Bah, you're so cold-hearted.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
哼，你真是冷血。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Is fighting Ancient Mummies going well?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
打狂暴木乃伊进展得怎么样？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I want to stop.
scripts.translation: 我想停止。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Good. Keep up the good work!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
很好。继续保持！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
What? You're so irresponsible!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
什么？你太不负责任了！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Cat]
Hey, you're actually useful! Good job!
That Ancient Mummy wouldn't dare come around here for a while, right? Muhahah!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的猫]
嘿，你果然派上用场了！干得好！
这样狂暴木乃伊短时间内就不敢靠近这里了，对吧？穆哈哈！
